A special radar made on Quent. Its strong metal detection lets you find items.
Custom data for running an ultralight frame stably. Raises mobility.
Custom data for running a heavily armored frame stably. Raises armor.
Deploys the air purge automatically. No more limits when moving on water.
A dedicated program for controlling heavy armor. Raises AT durability.
Ruthless tuning for the perfect soldier. Greatly raises critical hit rate.
Data for controlling units customized for swamp and underwater combat.
A program used by the Bloodsuckers that maxes shooting. Raises ammo and power.
PS-spec data built by the Secret Society. Brings out full mobility and melee.
Data of Martial's mightiest warrior. Greatly raises armor and attack.
The minimum data needed to run an AT. Reliably draws out its abilities.
Melee-focused data tuned by Battling pilots. Greatly raises melee.
Fearsome data that leads foes to death. Hugely raises attack in Battling only.
Power of a lost civilization no human can wield. Always boosts attack hugely.
Battling melee data from the Blue Knight. Its power pierces all.
Corrupted data. Barely enough to move an AT. Abilities drop sharply.
Uses spare magazines to refill bullets. Lets you keep more ammo on hand.
Shooting data that boosts heavy weapons through precise aim. Greatly raises shooting.
Deploys rough-terrain parts. Ignores terrain except rivers, but slower on flat ground.
Deploys the turbo for high-speed moves. But it takes skill to handle.
Ecrevisse's special move that defies AT logic. Even evades Combat Programs.
Fully nullifies shots and melee, but slowly drains the gauge while in use.
Dashes forward while guarding. Even evades Attack Programs while in use.
Lets you fire while guarding. Can nullify enemy shots.
Refills ammo for all weapons to max.
Lays a barrage in all directions with the right-hand weapon. Usable regardless of ammo.
Fire the right-hand weapon while leaping sideways. Immune to attacks meanwhile.
A quick 180-degree turn on the spot. Instantly faces foes behind you.
A high kick. Plain, but very versatile.
Pushes the unit to its limit for a while. MD gauge isn't used for a time.
Parries the target's melee attack backward with no damage.
Uses gun recoil to recover when knocked off balance. Auto-activates when downed.
Shadow Flare's booster function. Allows high speed but is very hard to handle.
The Blue Knight's booster function. Allows high speed but is very hard to handle.

Lunges at the foe's head and unleashes an Arm Punch.
A fierce, unmatched attack landing crushing blows on head and body.
Spins the unit and uses centrifugal force for a two-armed strike.
Rapid-fires the right-hand weapon to pin foes down. Rapid-fire weapons only.
Snipes a distant foe's legs with the right-hand weapon to knock it down. Never misses.
A melee technique striking hard at the foe's right side.
A melee technique striking hard at the foe's left side.
An advanced melee move: a jumping kick to the head with full body weight.
A melee technique: a spinning Arm Punch aimed at the foe's legs.
A melee move that slides the unit along the ground at speed to hit legs.

A deadly technique firing a steel stake by electromagnetism for a fatal blow.
A deadly technique shooting a steel stake like an arrow at a distant foe.
A melee move: charge shoulder-first and slam the foe to the ground.
A strong technique: tackle the foe, then shoot it down to finish it.
Charge shoulder-first, then follow up with the Pile Bunker. Fatty GA only.
An advanced melee move that pushes the agile Ecrevisse to its limit.
Zwerg's shooting technique: sweeps foes with its built-in arm machine guns.
A strong advanced move: rams the right steel claw into the body and tears upward.
An advanced move: rams the left steel claw into the body for fatal damage.
Shoots at the foe's feet, then strafes it hard once it falls.
Erdspinne's advanced technique: uses its cable to ram the foe.
Oder Buckler's advanced technique: uses its cable to ram the foe.
Deploys the Droppers Folding Gun to snipe distant foes. Very powerful.
A shooting technique: lay smoke and shoot the confused foe for big damage.
The Bloodsuckers' bloody finisher that sends foes to hell. Merciless.
A herald from hell that leads foes to death. The bloody red shoulder terrifies.

A melee technique that strikes the foe's left side and wrecks its left arm.
A melee technique that strikes the foe's lower body and wrecks its legs.
A melee technique that strikes the foe's head and wrecks its support systems.

A strong down attack: pounce on a fallen foe and crush it.
A strong down attack: a hard kick on a fallen foe.
A rough power move favored by Battling pilots. Strong enough for real combat.
A combo using the Arm Punch to deal fatal damage to the foe's body.
An upgraded lunge at the foe's head with an Arm Punch.
Fiercely rapid-fires the right-hand weapon to riddle foes. Rapid-fire weapons only.
A melee technique: a crushing blow to the foe's right side.
A melee technique: a crushing blow to the foe's left side.
A deadly technique driving a steel stake with strong gunpowder for a fatal blow.
A deadly technique firing a steel stake with great force at a distant foe.
An advanced move: rams the left steel claw into the body for devastating damage.
The Bloodsuckers' advanced move that sends foes to hell. The red wing marks a devil.

An expert melee move: a crushing strike to the left side that wrecks the left arm.
An expert melee move: a crushing strike to the lower body that wrecks the legs.
